**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind. I confirmed this by:

- **Reading § 3 (Contractor's Compensation)**, the planner's flagged location and the only pricing section. It covers time-and-materials compensation per SOW, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail, rate-change notice, and taxes — no benchmarking or price-matching covenant.
- **Full-document searches** for "most favoured/favored nation", "no less favorable", "favorable", "best price/pricing/terms/rates", and "other customers" — all returned zero hits.
- **Reviewing the section outline** to confirm no other section (Purpose, Ownership, Warranties, Termination, Liability) houses a stray pricing covenant.

This meets the **preferred position**: no MFN obligation runs against Clear Capital, and there is nothing to delete. Per the rule's direction analysis, there is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour to preserve.

One item noted in the rationale for information only, not flagged under this rule: § 3(b) permits RadialSpark to "change rates with 30 days notice to Company" without any cap or mutual-agreement requirement. That is a unilateral price-increase concern properly handled under the price-increase/rate-uplift rule, so I have not double-flagged the same commercial term here.
